szoveg_eredeti:
Today we're launching Perplexity Frontier Research.

The goal of Perplexity Frontier Research is to create a system that can perform autonomous research.

The work will focus on multi-agent orchestration, reinforcement learning, continual learning, systems, and pre-training.

We will develop algorithms, models, and evaluations, released openly, and tested in Perplexity products. Our work will be supported by more than 10,000 GPUs.

The Frontier Research team will regularly publish papers, models, data, and benchmarks.

We're actively hiring researchers and engineers for Perplexity Frontier Research in San Francisco, Palo Alto, New York, and London.
